# T-2: Persist review execution outcomes

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Route provider review results and tooling stages through one canonical evidence and CAS state transition path.

## Acceptance Criteria
- All review phases and task review normalize PASS, ADVISORY, and REJECTED into canonical evidence.
- Startup, subprocess, parse, post-hook, canonical write, and projection failures record separate TOOLING_ERROR stage and attempts without semantic findings.
- Immutable evidence writes, CAS state references, phase artifact projections, phase promotion, and retry accounting are idempotent for the same identity.
- Valid non-blocking disposition remains complete when a later projection fails.

## Implementation Notes
Update run-review, provider review command output, registry review lifecycle hooks, and phase artifact writing around the shared convergence module. Preserve target guards and revision checks before durable mutation.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local integration fixtures cover each disposition and failure stage, partial recording boundaries, repeated invocations, and phase/task lifecycle behavior.
